# nb-studio access

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## access catalog

Get what a role can hold

The businesses and settings items the assembled plugins registered with the authorization plugin: titles, descriptions, sections, and each business action with the levels it offers and the action that grants each.

```bash
nb-studio access catalog
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/access/catalog` (`accessGetCatalog`)

## access me

Get the caller’s own roles

```bash
nb-studio access me
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/access/me` (`accessGetMe`)

## access member list

List the members with their roles

Needs `pm.members` `read`. System administrators and API key identities are not listed; `meta.systemAdministratorCount` says how many administrators are not.

```bash
nb-studio access member list
```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `userId`, `name`, `email`, `roles`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/access/members` (`accessListMembers`)

## access member update

Replace a member’s roles

Needs `pm.members` `assign`; only an owner grants or revokes `owner`, and the last owner keeps it.

```bash
nb-studio access member update <user> --roles <string[]>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `user`   |             |

| Flag      | Type     | Description            |
| --------- | -------- | ---------------------- |
| `--roles` | string[] | (required; repeatable) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/access/members/{userId}` (`accessUpdateMember`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio access member update bob --roles admin
```

## access org-key create

Create an organization API key

Needs a signed-in session (every API key is refused) and `studio.apiKeys` `manage`. The secret is answered once. The key gets only what the caller holds (403 `KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_YOURS`).

```bash
nb-studio access org-key create
```

| Flag                | Type    | Description                                                       |
| ------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`            | string  |                                                                   |
| `--description`     | string  |                                                                   |
| `--expires-in-days` | integer |                                                                   |
| `--scope`           | json    |                                                                   |
| `--file`            | path    | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/organizationKeys` (`organizationKeysCreateKey`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio access org-key create --file key.json
```

## access org-key delete

Delete an organization API key

Needs a signed-in session (every API key is refused) and `studio.apiKeys` `manage`.

```bash
nb-studio access org-key delete <key>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `key`    |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                |
| ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this key? Whatever uses it stops working.” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/organizationKeys/{keyId}` (`organizationKeysDeleteKey`)

## access org-key rotate

Rotate an organization API key’s secret

Needs a signed-in session (every API key is refused) and `studio.apiKeys` `manage`. Keeps the identity, key id, name and permissions; the new secret is answered once.

```bash
nb-studio access org-key rotate <key>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `key`    |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Rotate this key? The old secret stops working.” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/organizationKeys/{keyId}/rotate` (`organizationKeysRotateKey`)

## access role create

```bash

```

| ------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--title`     | string   |                                                                   |
| `--pages`     | string[] | (repeatable)                                                      |
| `--settings`  | json     |                                                                   |
| `--abilities` | json     |                                                                   |
| `--file`      | path     | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/access/roles` (`accessCreateRole`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio access role create --file role.json
```

## access role delete

Delete a role

Needs `pm.members` `define-roles`. Built-in roles are not deleted (403 `ROLE_BUILT_IN`).

```bash
nb-studio access role delete <role>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `role`   |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                  |
| ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this role? Its holders lose what it grants.” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/access/roles/{roleKey}` (`accessDeleteRole`)

## access role update

Update a role

Needs `pm.members` `define-roles`. A field left out keeps what the role grants now; `owner` is not edited (403 `ROLE_NOT_EDITABLE`).

```bash
nb-studio access role update <role>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `role`   |             |

| Flag          | Type     | Description                                                       |
| ------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--title`     | string   |                                                                   |
| `--pages`     | string[] | (repeatable)                                                      |
| `--settings`  | json     |                                                                   |
| `--abilities` | json     |                                                                   |
| `--file`      | path     | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/access/roles/{roleKey}` (`accessUpdateRole`)
